scenes.vo: Một người đàn ông cầm lá bài hơn ba nghìn đô trên tay, rồi chạy mất, ngay trong buổi bán thẻ đầu tiên của hai cha con.
scenes.gloss: A man held a card worth over three thousand dollars in his hand, then ran off, right at the father and daughter's first card sale.
scenes.viewer: A stranger admiring the card at their table, then gone in a flash toward the doors; father and daughter left staring.

out.note: time jump back to the morning

scenes.build: the gym, their booth (easel empty, the case in his hands), the top-loader stand, the double doors.
scenes.blocking: Stranger at the stranger mark in front of the table, holding the case up at eye level; dad behind the table at the dad mark with his right palm open over the table (waiting to get it back); girl at the girl mark. From f103 the stranger runs to the doors (door_in) and out (door_out).
scenes.action: f0-96 he tilts the case to the light, admiring (two small tilts, f20 and f60); dad's palm stays open; f44 title $3,000+ ('hơn ba nghìn đô' f44-67); f100 his eyes slide to the doors; f103 ('chạy' f103) he spins and bolts: one-frame turn to the side view, a sprint at 4.5 m/s toward the doors with speed lines; his hip clips the table's right corner: the three top-loaders slide off and fall to the floor (f106-124) and lie there; f150-170 he hits the doors' push bar, they fly open; f137-183 'ngay trong buổi bán thẻ đầu tiên của hai cha con': the camera settles back on dad and girl behind their table, the FIRST SHOW! sign between them, faces from smile to shock (f150).
scenes.acting: Stranger: polite admiring smile -> sly glance -> sprint. Dad: proud smile, palm out -> frozen. Girl: beaming -> shock.

cams.why: the stranger with the card at their table, all three full body
whip after him: the run to the doors
father and daughter at their first booth, faces falling

scenes.light_mood: bright midday through the high windows.
scenes.sound: hall murmur; a sly pluck f100; a whoosh + Gogogogogo-style run cue f103; toploader clatter f118-124; the doors' bang f160; a suspense sting f150.
